IMAGE 2 is the NEW SINGLE COHERENT BACKGROUND insert. Output one 1280x800 full screenshot, same framing as IMAGE 1, no surrounding device or extra panel. Completely remove IMAGE 1's old tiled flooring and separately placed building strips. Use IMAGE 2's integrated architecture, roads, foundations and natural boundaries as one continuous environment; never add floating/pasted building props. Respect the existing WIDE SHORT map viewport: adapt the framing using a sensible crop and natural side extension if necessary, NOT by horizontally stretching or vertically flattening architecture. Keep recognizable city landmarks and their ground connections visible within this map viewport, not hidden by HUD. Keep the open playable clearing behind all three cards. LOCK all of IMAGE 1's top parchment HUD at y=0..85 and bottom parchment HUD at y=637..799: exact geometry, layout, colors, thin frames, all buttons, seals, typography, numbers, bottom card slots, one player portrait, mini-map frame and zoom toolbar at upper left must remain unchanged. Do NOT redesign, beautify, remove or add UI controls. LOCK the THREE existing field cards at the same exact positions, sizes, rotations, portraits, text, borders, bars and drop shadows as IMAGE 1. Do NOT add any characters or cards, do not replace cards with famous-hero mockups, do not enlarge them. Cards must be on the central flat dry open ground, never on roof, stairs, water, walls or trees. Only two UI content adjustments are permitted: update city name and minimap city-name title to the city requested below, and replace the thumbnail inside the same existing minimap frame with a matching overview of the new background while retaining its markers/view box styling. All other HUD labels and counters remain those of IMAGE 1 for comparison. Preserve IMAGE 2's premium Chinese historical hand-painted cel-animation style, blue-grey roofs, warm materials, consistent overhead perspective and warm sunlight. Quiet ground behind cards, restrained perimeter shadows, no clutter. No caption, no new logo, no watermark, no extra HUD. This is a visual concept, not a new layout.

The three cards stand on the broad calm stone plaza. Architecture must sit at the perimeter, not float among the cards.

No game code, runtime textures, gameplay data or saves were modified.
